control: Enterprise audit logging and tamper-evident audit chain live validation
summary: EuroComply audit events are appended to an organization-scoped hash chain with deterministic canonical payload hashing, optional HMAC signatures, sanitized metadata, sanitized request context, transactional Supabase RPC append, RBAC plus step-up protected verification, CLI verification, and signed audit evidence export. Enterprise release remains blocked until target Supabase execution through scripts/security/run-audit-chain-live-validation.mjs and reviewer confirmation are attached.
redactionScope: Evidence contains only synthetic ids, file paths, control names, status fields and hash prefixes. Secrets, tokens, cookies, service-role keys, full organization identifiers, connection strings and access-granting values are excluded.
controlsVerified: Each chained audit event stores organizationId, actorUserId, action, entityType, entityId, sanitized metadata, sanitized requestContext, previousHash, eventHash, hash algorithm and optional HMAC signature.
Audit event canonicalization sorts object keys recursively and removes undefined values before hashing.
Audit event canonicalization normalizes database timestamptz strings before hashing so rows read back from Postgres verify against the originally persisted event_hash.
eventHash includes the canonicalized payload and previousHash.
The enterprise append RPC uses pg_advisory_xact_lock per organization and validates p_previous_hash inside the transaction before insert.
The enterprise append RPC persists p_id and p_created_at so the stored row matches the canonical payload that was hashed.

Application append fails closed by default when the transactional RPC is unavailable; non-transactional fallback requires AUDIT_CHAIN_ALLOW_NON_TRANSACTIONAL_FALLBACK=true and is not the enterprise default.
Verification endpoint requires authenticated user, organization context, read_audit RBAC, business plan entitlement, rate limiting and audit_chain_verify step-up.
Verification attempts are appended as audit_chain.verified events after verification completes.
Audit evidence export requires export_data RBAC and audit_chain_export step-up, and fails closed when the evidence cannot be signed.
Offline CLI verification detects missing_previous_hash, previous_hash_mismatch, event_hash_mismatch and signature_mismatch.

Target live validation script performs normal append, concurrent stale-previous-hash append, retry append, readback verification, tamper detection and missing previous hash detection against the configured Supabase project.

exception.rationale: Repository evidence proves implementation wiring and fail-closed behavior, but enterprise audit-chain release requires target Supabase live validation before any enterprise claim or procurement use.
compensatingControls: Enterprise release remains No-Go until target live validation evidence is attached.
External security review gate also remains Open and independently blocks enterprise release.
Audit evidence export and verification remain RBAC plus step-up protected and fail closed without signing material.

operationalNotes: Run Supabase migration supabase/migrations/20260621120000_audit_chain_enterprise_hardening.sql before enabling enterprise audit-chain verification in production.
Set AUDIT_CHAIN_SIGNING_SECRET for event hash signatures and EVIDENCE_PACK_SIGNING_SECRET for signed evidence exports.
Do not enable AUDIT_CHAIN_ALLOW_NON_TRANSACTIONAL_FALLBACK in enterprise production environments.
Run scripts/security/run-audit-chain-live-validation.mjs against the target Supabase project with AUDIT_CHAIN_LIVE_ORGANIZATION_ID set to a controlled organization id.
After reviewing the generated JSON and confirming the synthetic audit rows in target Supabase, rerun with AUDIT_CHAIN_LIVE_PROOF=true to mark the evidence Complete.
Offline reviewers can run node scripts/security/verify-audit-chain.mjs --input <audit-events.json> against exported evidence.
limitations: This repository evidence validates implementation wiring and deterministic failure behavior. Enterprise release remains blocked until target Supabase live validation is executed and reviewer proof is attached.
